Marufi Digital/Privacy policy

Privacy policy.

How Marufi Digital handles your information. Last updated September 24, 2026.

A note on this text. It was prepared as a starting point for Marufi Digital and reflects how the store actually works. Have it reviewed by a lawyer for your province and the countries you sell to before relying on it.

Who we are

Marufi Digital is an independent publisher of digital guides, books, immigration and settling-in help, restaurant lists, and checklists, sold as downloads. You can reach us through the contact page.

What we collect, and why

  • When you buy. Checkout is run by Stripe. Stripe collects your name, e-mail address, billing country, and payment details. We never see your card number. We receive your name, e-mail, country, and what you bought so that we can deliver your files, send receipts and download links, answer support questions, and keep the accounting records the law requires.
  • When you download. Download links are signed and time-limited. We log which files were served, when, and from which address, to prevent abuse.
  • When you ask to be told about a place. We keep your e-mail and the place you asked for, and write to you once when it is covered.
  • When you subscribe to the newsletter. We keep your e-mail and the date. Where e-mail is configured you confirm by clicking a link first (double opt-in). Every newsletter has an unsubscribe link.
  • When you contact us. We keep your name, e-mail, and message so that we can reply.
  • When you look up your purchases. We e-mail a one-time code to the address you enter and show the orders placed with that address. Codes expire after ten minutes.
  • When you send a gift. We use the recipient's e-mail only to deliver the gift and keep it with the order record.

The legal bases, where they apply, are performance of a contract (orders, downloads, support), your consent (newsletter, notify-me requests), and our legitimate interest in running the store securely and keeping accounts.

Cookies and local storage

The store sets no advertising or tracking cookies. Your browser's local storage holds your cart, saved titles, compare list, chosen currency, and a flag so the opening animation plays once per visit. That data stays on your device. Stripe sets its own cookies on the checkout page for fraud prevention; see Stripe's privacy policy.

If analytics are enabled, we use either Plausible (cookieless, no personal data) or Google Analytics 4 with IP anonymisation. The current setting is shown in the site's source and in this policy's contact section on request.

Who processes data for us

  • Stripe for payments, receipts, and refunds.
  • Cloudflare for hosting the store's server, file storage, and delivery.
  • Resend for sending receipts, download links, codes, and newsletters.
  • GitHub Pages or our own web host for serving the site itself.

Some of these providers are outside Canada and the European Economic Area. They rely on standard contractual clauses or equivalent safeguards.

How long we keep it

Order records for seven years, as tax law requires. Notify-me requests until we write to you or you ask us to delete them. Newsletter subscriptions until you unsubscribe. Contact messages for up to two years. Server logs for thirty days.

Your rights

Under Canada's PIPEDA and provincial privacy laws, and under the GDPR and UK GDPR for readers in the EU, EEA, and UK, you can ask for a copy of the personal information we hold, ask us to correct or delete it, object to or restrict certain processing, take your data elsewhere, and withdraw consent at any time. E-mail us and we will answer within thirty days. You can also complain to the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada or to your local data-protection authority.

Children

The store is not aimed at children under sixteen and we do not knowingly collect their information.

Changes

If this policy changes in a way that matters, we update the date at the top and, for material changes, tell newsletter subscribers.

Contact

Questions about privacy: use the contact page.
